---
title: Copilot Instructions
description: Repository-specific instructions for AI coding assistants working in this template
---

## Intent

This repository is a reusable template for React, .NET, Azure, and Aspire projects.

## Required Agent Behavior

* Read TEMPLATE_INSTRUCTIONS.md before making project-specific edits.
* Collect and apply questionnaire answers.
* Keep placeholders and naming parallelism consistent.
* Use optional commented sections for feature switches.

## Architecture Baseline

* Frontend: template-app
* Backend: template-service
* Infra: Bicep in infra folder
* Docs: VitePress in docs folder
* Automation: GitHub workflows in .github/workflows
